title: Venture Capital - Silicon Valley Ponzi Scheme - Chamath Palihapitiya
summary: A 13-minute clip from This Week in Startups in which Chamath Palihapitiya describes venture capital as a Ponzi-like scheme driven by fees and inflated valuations among VCs.
why: Cited in threads about startups, VC and private equity as an insider's description of how VC economics work, though commenters note he is self-serving.

quote.text: This video is a good explanation of how the VC world actually works.
